1.VESO PD
for most, the only PD training




Most typical PD format, municipalities and/or
schools are responsible about that

VESO PD?
“A teacher who has been hired for the time being and a fixed-term teacher who
has been hired for at least the full working time of the academic year are
obliged to participate in study and planning work for a total of 18 hours
during the academic year.”

Teachers' working days and hours are decided by the school or
municipality. It is also possible to agree with the employee to replace working
hours with other similar training.

B. Regional state administrative
 agency (AVI)
AVI organized and delivered the training itself (not
through external providers).
The training was short-term and covers current topics
relevant to education, early childhood education,
libraries, youth work, and sports.
The schedule and topics were published on the AVI
events and training calendar.
Participation was free of charge for education
professionals.
